evidence: Home page shows 6 template cards each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description text.
Each card shows title, author, description, category badge (e.g. Resume), scenario badge (e.g. Business), usage count (e.g. 1,250 uses), and updated date (e.g. Updated 2024-12-01).
Clicking Use Template on Professional Resume opened a preview panel with Fill Template/Preview Result tabs, template title, and list of form fields.
preview.missing-fields shows 'Required fields missing Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, ...' and Preview Result tab is disabled (not enabled) until fields filled.

All 14 declared fields (name, title, email, phone, summary, company, position, startDate, endDate, responsibilities, degree, school, graduationYear, skills) accepted input values as confirmed by semantic_snapshot showing each field's value.
After filling all required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and showed rendered resume with values substituted (John Doe, Software Engineer, Acme Corp — Senior Engineer, etc.)

Preview rendered Markdown correctly: H1 name heading, strong job title, separator line, H2 section headings (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), emphasis for date range, and all placeholders replaced with entered values.
Preview Result tab was disabled/unclickable when required fields were empty (timeout error on click attempt), and became enabled only after all required fields were filled with valid values.
Markdown template (Professional Resume) rendered proper Markdown structure (headings, emphasis, separator) with all field values substituted correctly.
Clicking Copy to Clipboard copied the Markdown-formatted result to clipboard (verified via navigator.clipboard.readText()) and button text changed to 'Copied!' as visible feedback.
Clicking the favorite toggle in the preview panel set its state to 'on' and the header Favorites button badge updated to show count '1' immediately.

actual: Entering 'not-an-email' into the Email field (a field with declared email format) was accepted without error, the Preview Result tab remained enabled, and the invalid value was substituted directly into the generated preview ('Software Engineer | not-an-email | 555-1234') instead of being rejected or blocking the preview.

evidence: Entering special characters (<, >, |, backtick) into the Professional Summary field triggered field error 'Special characters like < > { } [ ] \\ | ` are not allowed' and the Preview Result tab became disabled again, blocking preview generation.

Category filter 'Resume' reduced results to 1/6 (Professional Resume); Scenario filter 'Academic' reduced to 1/6 (Academic Research Summary); Sort 'Alphabetical' reordered all 6 items alphabetically (Academic Research Summary, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report).
Category, scenario, and sort changes updated filters.result-count and templates.grid ordering/content immediately without any page navigation/reload.

actual: Typing 'Resme' (a one-letter-missing typo of 'Resume') produced no suggestions and 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' / 'No templates found', instead of returning or suggesting the 'Professional Resume' template.

evidence: Typing 're' (2 chars) showed real-time suggestions (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, Degree, Weekly Status Report, In Progress); clicking 'Professional Resume' filled the search box with that text and narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates'.

Toggled favorite on for Professional Resume and Weekly Status Report (count went to 2); opening Favorites-only view showed exactly those 2 templates; removing Weekly Status Report favorite reduced count to 1 and view updated to show only Professional Resume.
While in Favorites-only view (2 favorites), searching 'Weekly' narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' showing only Weekly Status Report, confirming search works within favorites-only mode.
Submit Template dialog accepted title, description, author, category, scenario, Markdown content with placeholders, and 4 defined fields (Hiring Manager, Job Title, Closing, Applicant Name).

After submitting, the library updated to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' with 'Simple Cover Letter' visible; clicking Use Template opened its custom form, and filling fields + previewing produced correct substituted output.
Clicking Submit Template with all fields blank kept the dialog open and did not add a new template (grid remained at 6/6 after the attempt).

Custom template with 4 fields (hiring_manager, job_title, closing, applicant_name) exactly matching content placeholders submitted successfully; generated preview 'Dear Ms. Jane Smith, I am writing to apply for the Frontend Developer position. I look forward to hearing from you. Sincerely, Timothee Issenmann' contained no unresolved {{...}} placeholders.

Each of the 4 distinctly-labeled fields (Hiring Manager, Job Title, Closing, Applicant Name) was independently fillable in the Use Template form, each retaining its own entered value verified via semantic_snapshot.
Immediately after clicking Submit Template (no reload), filters.result-count changed from 'Showing 6 of 6 templates' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' and the new template card appeared in the grid.

After navigating to the app URL again (reload), favorites count remained '1' with Professional Resume still favorited, and the custom 'Simple Cover Letter' template remained in the library (Showing 7 of 7 templates).
